expenditures.detail: delta +900.00 (rows 41,412.59 vs stated/printed TOTAL 40,512.59). This is FILER ARITHMETIC on an amendment, not a read error: every amount cell on BOTH Schedule B pages was re-rendered as a tight column crop at 900 dpi and re-read, and not one figure changed. The page evidence is internally inconsistent in two separate places: (1) p5's printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE is 9,604.55 while its own 14 rows sum to 7,604.55 - a 2,000.00 gap exactly the size of one of the two identical 'The Target Group / Management / 2,000' rows on that page; and (2) p6's SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell was left BLANK, so the printed TOTAL 40,512.59 cannot be checked against a chain of subtotals at all. 40,512.59 minus p5's printed subtotal 9,604.55 leaves 30,908.04 for p6, but p6's rows sum to 33,808.04. No row was adjusted, no subtotal was recomputed, and the stated total is retained verbatim.

itemized.notes: 6-page filing and an AMENDMENT: the cover carries a hand-written 'April 2008 Amendment # 2' at the top, the amendment question is ticked YES with date 2/14/13, and every schedule page is hand-annotated 'Amend 2/14/13'. NO Type-of-Report box is checked (the printed period options on this cover are the 2012 dates, another sign the 2012 form stock was reused to amend a 2008 report), so the report type comes only from the hand-written header - the filename's 'April' is consistent with p6's 'Date of Report 4-07-08' but is not a checked box. Page order is standard: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3-p4 Schedule A (1 of 2, 2 of 2), p5-p6 Schedule B (1 of 2, 2 of 2). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed on all four schedule pages - every filled row has a date, a name and an amount, counts match column by column, and the 'in Kind' marks sit in the right MARGIN on Schedule A (outside the table) and INSIDE the Purpose cell on Schedule B, never in a date cell. The Complete Mailing Address column is blank on all 22 contributor rows, so no donor geography exists to record; the black redaction bars on this document are confined to the cover's street-address and phone/fax/email blocks. Six of the eleven p6 expenditures are in-kind items that pair with in-kind CONTRIBUTIONS on Schedule A (POC Inc 6,000, Wasatch Pacific 6,000, Dewey Reagan 6,000, Cottonwood 6,000, Jordan Hills 4,000) - the form's double-entry convention, not duplicates. One p6 recipient ('Cottonwood Dealbau') is only partly legible and is left at low confidence with needs_review=1 rather than completed into a plausible business name. One p6 purpose cell is a DITTO mark, resolved to the row above and noted. THE THING A HUMAN SHOULD LOOK AT: the +900.00 expenditure residual and p5's 2,000.00 subtotal gap described in the recon and gate fields - both survive a 900 dpi re-read of every amount cell, so they are the filer's own arithmetic on a five-year-late amendment.
